classes.name: EmployeeLeaveBalanceAPI

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve a list of an employee's leave balances with optional filters for date range and sorting.

methods.name: getEmployeeLeaveBalancesResult
methods.description: Compiles leave balance data for all leave types based on search filters, returning an array of leave balance models.

methods.name: getFromAndToDates
methods.description: Determines the date range for leave balance retrieval, defaulting to current leave period if not specified.
